description: Protección Civil is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. This data set includes a directory with the data of the Civil Protection points of Zaragoza. Through the Visualization Service, the City of Zaragoza makes available a visualization in which data on Civil Protection points are shown. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. The portal shows the English title as "Civil Protection" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. Its keywords include protección y seguridad ciudadana, seguridad, seguridad pública, protección civil, bomberos. The listing shows 3 download or service links in JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2022-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.zaragoza.es/sede/portal/aviso-legal#condiciones). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
